about.pageDescription: Learn a little more about my journey and experience
about.name: Marcos Jhollyfer Rodrigues
about.bio1: The first Tikuna Indigenous Software Engineer from the Amazon. I was born and raised in the Amazon region, and I bring this unique experience to every project I develop, combining technology and social impact.
about.bio2: Software Engineer with over 5 years of experience in web, mobile and backend application development. My passion for programming started in my teenage years and since then I have been improving my knowledge and technical skills.
about.bio3: Currently, I work as a full-stack developer, creating complete solutions from frontend to backend. I have experience with various modern technologies and frameworks, always seeking to deliver high-quality products.
about.bio4: My main goal is to create scalable, well-documented and high-quality solutions. I enjoy working in teams and am always looking for new challenges and opportunities to learn and grow professionally.
